event.title: Reject empty passwords in login()
event.body: `login()` currently accepts empty passwords. This adds a guard that returns False when the password is blank, plus a regression test.
event.diff:
--- a/src/auth.py
+++ b/src/auth.py
@@
 def login(user, pw):
+    if not pw:
+        return False
     return True
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_auth.py
@@
+def test_login_rejects_empty_password():
+    assert login("alice", "") is False
